disclaimers: Uniform hourly rate for both Early Voting and Election Day poll workers
disclosure_of_risks: Long Election Day (up to ~14 hours); early voting requires 8-12 day availability
objective_evidence: County Elections Department published pay rate
party: El Paso County, Texas, Elections Department (county)

standard.s2: Poll worker / Election Day poll worker
standard.s3: Current pay $15.00 per hour for both Early Voting poll workers and Election Day poll workers. No per-role differential published.
standard.s4: Must be 18+ and a registered voter in El Paso County; familiar with computers; mandatory training; background checks conducted on all poll workers; bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
standard.s5: Official Election Day shift: 6:00 a.m. until approximately 8:00 p.m. Early Voting shifts vary 8-12 hours per day over an 8-12 day period.
standard.s6: Election Day ~14 hours (6:00 a.m.-~8:00 p.m.); Early Voting 8-12 hours/day.
